title: Container Bookings: transmitting the shipper's verified gross mass declaration
content:
## What the tool does
For the Container Bookings product line, **submit_vgm_declaration_120f73ac** transmits the shipper's own signed verified gross mass declaration for a booking to the line, so that it is recorded as received now. The shipper performs this itself, as the party responsible for the verified gross mass: one call records the current moment as the time the booking's verified gross mass was received by the line, replacing any earlier receipt time on the booking. Nothing else on the booking and no charge is changed. Afterwards the booking shows the verified gross mass as received at that moment.

## How it is invoked
This is a customer-side tool: the agent must first unlock it and hand it over, and it is then run by the customer themselves. The agent does not run it on the customer's behalf.

## Parameters
| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| booking_id | the booking reference number of the booking the declaration is for, as given to the shipper by the service agent from the booking lookup | identifier |

## Return
The tool returns a text rendering of a dictionary confirming the transmission: booking_id (the booking the declaration was recorded on), document (always verified_gross_mass) and received_at (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM in the local time of the clock the line records, the moment recorded as receipt). A returned received_at means the declaration is on record.

## Points of judgement
**Does the transmission book a fee?** No. It records only the receipt time; no charge is changed.

**What if a receipt time was already on the booking?** The new transmission replaces the earlier receipt time.
